notes: Competing framings of one award, none resolvable to a single confirmed number. NASA: $188M base with an option period worth $280.4M for two task orders (CX-2 task order under CLPS 1.0). Spaceflight Now: $234M for each LTV delivered, which equals (188 + 280.4) / 2. Reuters: flat $188M with no option mentioned. Washington Post syndication: at least $188M. The 'up to $468M for two missions' framing appears in no source's own text; it is arithmetic (188 + 280.4 = 468.4) and is a derived framing, not a reported one. Option exercise is contingent on performance and has not occurred.
